_meanings:
Applicable to the whole of
 a radical term, or to the complete form of the verbal base after the conjugational
 characteristics have been affixed, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} to the four conjugational
 or special tenses.

<ab>N.</ab> of the verbal terminations of the four conjugational tenses
 (strictly, the personal terminations of all tenses and moods except the
 Perfect and Benedictive and the affixes distinguished by a mute {#S#}).
